questions.question: Each of the letters in the word 'REDUCTION' are arranged in the English alphabetical order. How many letters are there in the English alphabetical order between the letter which is the third from the left end and the fourth from the left end in the group of letters thus formed?
questions.questionHtml: Each of the letters in the word 'REDUCTION' are arranged in the English alphabetical order. How many letters are there in the English alphabetical order between the letter which is the third from the left end and the fourth from the left end in the group of letters thus formed?
questions.solution:
After arranged in alphabetical order,

Third alphabet from the left end is: E, Fourth alphabet from the left end is: I,

And, there are 3 letters between E and I.

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'A ? B' means ‘A is the mother of B’, 'A ! B' means ‘A is the wife of B’, 'A & B' means ‘A is the brother of B’ and 'A x B' means ‘A is the father of B’. Which of the following means that Z is the wife's father's mother of L?
questions.questionHtml:
In a certain code language,
'A ? B' means ‘A is the mother of B’,
'A ! B' means ‘A is the wife of B’,
'A & B' means ‘A is the brother of B’ and
'A x B' means ‘A is the father of B’.
Which of the following means that Z is the wife's father's mother of L?

options.text: Z & B ! T x J ? L
options.html: Z & B ! T x J ? L

options.text: Z ! B x T ? J & L
options.html: Z ! B x T ? J & L

options.text: Z ? B x T & J ! L
options.html: Z ? B x T & J ! L

options.text: Z ? B ! T & J x L
options.html: Z ? B ! T & J x L

questions.solution:
iii. Z ? B x T & J ! L → Z is the mother of B who is the father of T who is the brother of J who is the wife of L. 

Here, Z is L's wife's father's mother.

questions.question: Six letters B, F, D, X, N and A are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figures below. Find the letter on the face opposite to D.
questions.questionHtml: Six letters B, F, D, X, N and A are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figures below. Find the letter on the face opposite to D.
questions.solution:
As D is common on both the dices, it is clear that F, B, X, and N are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. A will be opposite to it.

​

Opposite pairs: F → N, B → X, D → A

questions.question: Two sets of numbers are given below. In each set of numbers, certain mathematical operation(s) on the first number result(s) in the second number. Similarly, certain mathematical operation(s) on the second number result(s) in the third number and so on. Which of the given options follows the same set of operations as in the given sets? (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.) 9 – 27 – 31 – 36; 10 – 30 – 34 – 39
questions.questionHtml:
Two sets of numbers are given below. In each set of numbers, certain mathematical operation(s) on the first number result(s) in the second number. Similarly, certain mathematical operation(s) on the second number result(s) in the third number and so on. Which of the given options follows the same set of operations as in the given sets?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

9 – 27 – 31 – 36; 10 – 30 – 34 – 39
questions.solution: Logic: 1st number × 3 = 2nd number; 2nd number + 4 = 3rd number; 3rd number + 5 = 4th number. Similarly, for 5 – 15 – 19 – 24 ⇒ 5 × 3 = 15; ⇒ 15 + 4 = 19; ⇒ 19 + 5 = 24
